Whether the custom franchise (XPU plus XPU-attach) converts the just-raised out-year case into delivered revenue at hyperscalers management will not name or size, while every incremental point of custom mix takes non-GAAP gross margin lower (65.1% peak -> 58.9% in Q2 FY2027, guided 57.5-58.5% for Q3) and operating leverage is the only offset.
